_readme: Announced S&P 500 / S&P 100 constituent changes, hand-maintained (IP-LAW-7: static data is JSON).
S&P Dow Jones Indices publishes no free API, so YOU log each change here when it is announced —
IndexEventScanner turns every entry into a ResearchClaim (ClaimType = IndexEvent) on its next pass
and flips it from Pending to Realized once effectiveDate passes. Entries are idempotent: edit freely.
effectiveDate (yyyy-MM-dd or null when TBA), sourceUrl (press release; null lowers source trust), note.
